cap: With the follicles gone, the ovary stops sending estradiol and inhibin B back to the hypothalamus and pituitary, so GnRH, LH and above all FSH rise. The same loss of estrogen unleashes KNDy neurons, whose neurokinin B signal at NK3 receptors narrows the thermoneutral zone and produces hot flashes, the step fezolinetant blocks. The estrogen that remains is estrone, made in fat from adrenal and stromal androstenedione.
